data.turoyo: W koḥayrono hbiṭono bu=gabano koḥayrono b hano koḥayrono maz=zuḥṯe, w azzino
data.translation: Ich war erschrocken, ängstlich blickte ich in diese Richtung und diese Richtung, und ich ging (zu meiner Sandale).

rationale: Third Detransitive Preterit example; fear state backgrounds repeated looking after a snake encounter.

data.translation: Ich habe mich sehr erschreckt, nicht nur Angst gehabt (wörtl.: was [heißt], ich habe Angst gehabt.)

rationale: Fourth example; explicit contrast with zʕy in the speaker’s own evaluation of fright versus fear.

data.turoyo: Mḥawaṭṭe u=maṭʕam, hani hbiṭi, maʕlalle iḏayye,
data.translation: Als sie das Speisehaus umstellten, wurden jene von Schrecken gepackt und hoben die Hände hoch.

rationale: Fifth example; plural experiencer agreement and fright followed by raised hands.

data.turoyo: Kəllən at tarʕe kulle w aš šəbebək kulle ftiḥe. Hbəṭno!“ Omər: “Hbəṭno ġalabe.
data.translation: All the doors and all the windows are there, open. I was frightened!' He says, 'I was very frightened.

rationale: Unusual hbəṭno variant justifies one example despite the full round-1 cell; both tokens share this quotation.

summary: All five occurrences were checked. The entry’s tentative (Detrans.?) Schrecken bekommen and hbīṭ/məhbəṭ base forms are retained without inventing an active causative counterpart.

Experiencers are coded as subjects: first-person hbiṭono, third-singular priest and plural hbiṭi. Fright follows a contextual trigger; no agent phrase or ordinary caused-event interpretation is expressed.
JL 6.10/14 backgrounds scanning with a fear state, while /16 explicitly contrasts hbiṭono with zayiʕono. This supports the existing fright gloss; it does not justify another intensity sense.
PrS 76/29 is already the inherited prs 223/30 priest example; JL 6.10/18 is also inherited. New additions fill the cell from two to five.

Round 2 only. Jan English is a project machine translation, not an edition translation; all semantic decisions rest on the Turoyo. Round-1 proposals are inherited in the reading layout and are not repeated in this JSON.
Jan hbəṭno contrasts with round-1 hbiṭono while preserving the same subject-coded fright experiencer. The shorter vowel and ending are retained literally.
Open doors/windows form the contextual trigger. ġalabe adds degree to repeated fright, not another lexical sense. The inherited tentative Detransitive classification stays tentative.
